Session 55ff81c5-3734-498f-a8e5-66cab7a33c86 (started 07:48:16Z, stop committed 07:52:15Z) persisted zero server events because it was scoped to node f6920091, which held no creature or encounter. Read-only inspection shows the scheduler fired every 2s and the dispatcher returned 200, yet no tick was committed in the window (no node_tick_log rows after 07:40Z; the active encounter stayed at tick 20 with unconsumed pending events and an unresolved queued departure). The failing boundary lies between claim acquisition and commit inside the worker, and remains unproven pending an authorized instrumented run. The creature's stale HP came from a pre-existing node_creature row at another node, untouched.

Instrumentation only; no root gameplay fix. Read-only inspection of the preserved encounter 2e7249d4 (node f45a8b21) at 2026-09-21T11:57Z proved the claim boundary succeeds repeatedly (claimed_tick 21 against committed tick 20, claim_expires_at renewed each dispatcher cycle, state_version 29) while no tick commits, so the failing step lies after claim acquisition and at or before commit. The exact step was unprovable because the dispatcher logged only aggregate counts and diagnostic persistence was best-effort after the worker returned. The corrected dispatcher logs per-node classification, reason, stage and code, resolves recording sessions before worker execution, and persists dispatcher selection plus the last reached phase and a sanitized failure classification from a catch/finally path. Worker invocation remains exactly once per candidate; no lock, idempotency, cadence, lease, scheduler or gameplay-rule change.

ROOT CAUSE PROVEN, installed SQL contract is behind the deployed worker. The bounded recording showed claim_attempted -> claim_acquired (tick 21) -> snapshot_rejected, 9 cycles, tick frozen at 20. Read-only inspection of the installed public.node_tick_claim chain (node_tick_claim -> node_tick_claim_without_boss_timing -> node_tick_claim_without_canary_gate) shows the creature projection emits id, creature_id, spawn_seq, hp, is_alive, pending_action, tank_fighter_id, engaged, name, level, max_hp, ac, stats, rarity, is_humanoid, is_aggressive, boss_crit_flavors, boss_death_cry, loot_mode, loot_table_id, drop_chance and loot_table only. public.creatures has no gold_enabled, gold_min, gold_max, gold_chance, salvage_enabled or item_source column. The fail-closed decoder in src/shared/combat2/decode.ts (decodeCreature) requires all six, so it rejects every claim at snapshot.creatures[i].gold_enabled (expected boolean), .gold_min/.gold_max/.gold_chance (expected finite number), .salvage_enabled (expected boolean) and .item_source (expected non-empty string); decode never returns, so resolve and commit are unreachable. The fields are added only by the unapplied 20260915200000 reward-channels migration, whose ADM-025B assertions abort. No decoder weakening was performed: nothing may fabricate reward configuration. Correction delivered as an authored, unapplied contract-only forward migration plus a regression fixture reproducing the sanitized installed shape. Not live-verified: no tick has committed beyond 20.
